title: MIPI DPI transmitter: programmable parallel RGB video timing (front porch, sync, back porch, active in both directions), 1 pixel per clock, 24 or 18-bit colour

words.name: CTRL
words.desc: [0] enable, [1] shutdown (outputs low, position held), [2] 18-bit colour (2 LSBs of each channel cleared). Enabling with a timing register at 0 or a total above 65536 is refused (CFG_ERR)

words.name: FRAME
words.desc: [15:0] frames sent (wraps; also on the frame_cnt pins)

words.name: HCNT
words.desc: [15:0] current pixel in the line (0 while disabled)

irqs.name: CFG_ERR
irqs.desc: an enable was refused (invalid timing); level in the core until the next accepted CTRL write, so the bit is set again on every clock until then

notes: pclk (= PCLK), hsync / vsync (active high), de, rgb[23:0], the pixel[23:0] input (sampled in the active region) and frame_cnt[15:0] pass through unchanged.

Each core register takes bits [15:0] of a whole-word write. Frame order: front porch, sync, back porch, active, horizontally and vertically. Timing registers may change while running; a counter already past a new total wraps at once.
